mapper.sql: select e.*, p.provider selected_place_provider,p.provider_place_id selected_place_provider_id, coalesce(p.place_name,e.place_name) selected_place_name,p.place_type selected_place_type, coalesce(p.address,e.place_address) selected_place_address, p.province selected_place_province,p.city selected_place_city,p.district selected_place_district, p.province_code selected_place_province_code,p.city_code selected_place_city_code, p.district_code selected_place_district_code,p.latitude selected_place_latitude, p.longitude selected_place_longitude,p.coordinate_system selected_place_coordinate_system, (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like l where l.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id) like_count, (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment c where c.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id and c.del_flag='0') comment_count, (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_resource r where r.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id) media_count, case when #{currentUserId} is not null and exists( select 1 from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like mine where mine.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id and mine.shop_user_id=#{currentUserId} ) then true else false end liked_by_me from shop_zhenke_enjoy e left join shop_place p on p.place_id=e.place_id and p.status='0'
mapper.select: where e.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and e.del_flag='0' and e.status='0' and p.place_id is not null
mapper.insert: insert into shop_zhenke_enjoy(category,title,subtitle,cover_url,service_summary,content,highlights,opening_hours,contact_phone,place_id,place_name,place_address,display_sort,status,del_flag,published_at,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{category},#{title},#{subtitle},#{coverUrl},#{serviceSummary},#{content},#{highlights},#{openingHours},#{contactPhone},#{placeId},#{placeName},#{placeAddress},#{displaySort},#{status},'0',case when #{status}='0' then sysdate() else null end,#{createBy},sysdate(),#{updateBy},sysdate())
mapper.update: update shop_zhenke_enjoy set category=#{category},title=#{title},subtitle=#{subtitle},cover_url=#{coverUrl},service_summary=#{serviceSummary},content=#{content},highlights=#{highlights},opening_hours=#{openingHours},contact_phone=#{contactPhone},place_id=#{placeId},place_name=#{placeName},place_address=#{placeAddress},display_sort=#{displaySort},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0'
update shop_zhenke_enjoy set del_flag='2',update_by=#{user},update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0'

update shop_zhenke_enjoy set status=#{status},published_at=case when #{status}='0' then coalesce(published_at,sysdate()) else published_at end,update_by=#{user},update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy e join shop_place p on p.place_id=e.place_id and p.status='0' where e.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and e.del_flag='0' and e.cover_url is not null and e.cover_url!='' and e.service_summary is not null and e.service_summary!='' and exists(select 1 from shop_zhenke_enjoy_resource r where r.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id)
select resource_url from shop_zhenke_enjoy_resource where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} order by resource_sort,resource_id
mapper.insert: insert ignore into shop_zhenke_enjoy_like(enjoy_id,shop_user_id,create_time) select #{enjoyId},#{shopUserId},sysdate() from shop_zhenke_enjoy where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'
mapper.delete: delete from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId}
mapper.sql: select c.*,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,coalesce(ru.nick_name,ru.user_name) reply_to_name,case when c.parent_comment_id is null then (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment reply_count where reply_count.enjoy_id=c.enjoy_id and reply_count.parent_comment_id=c.comment_id and reply_count.del_flag='0') else 0 end reply_count from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment c join shop_zhenke_enjoy e on e.enjoy_id=c.enjoy_id and e.del_flag='0' join shop_user u on u.user_id=c.shop_user_id left join shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment rc on rc.comment_id=c.reply_to_comment_id left join shop_user ru on ru.user_id=rc.shop_user_id
mapper.select: where c.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and c.parent_comment_id is null and c.del_flag='0' order by c.create_time desc,c.comment_id desc

select ranked.* from ( select c.*,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,coalesce(ru.nick_name,ru.user_name) reply_to_name,0 reply_count, row_number() over(partition by c.parent_comment_id order by c.create_time,c.comment_id) reply_rank from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment c join shop_zhenke_enjoy e on e.enjoy_id=c.enjoy_id and e.del_flag='0' join shop_user u on u.user_id=c.shop_user_id left join shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment rc on rc.comment_id=c.reply_to_comment_id left join shop_user ru on ru.user_id=rc.shop_user_id where c.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and c.del_flag='0' and c.parent_comment_id in #{rootCommentId} ) ranked where ranked.reply_rank <= #{previewSize} order by ranked.parent_comment_id,ranked.create_time,ranked.comment_id
where c.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and c.parent_comment_id=#{rootCommentId} and c.del_flag='0' order by c.create_time,c.comment_id
where c.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and c.comment_id=#{commentId} and c.del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: insert into shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment(enjoy_id,parent_comment_id,reply_to_comment_id,shop_user_id,content,del_flag,create_time,update_time) select #{enjoyId},#{parentCommentId},#{replyToCommentId},#{shopUserId},#{content},'0',sysdate(),sysdate() from shop_zhenke_enjoy where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'
mapper.update: update shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment set del_flag='2',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and comment_id=#{commentId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and del_flag='0'

update shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment set del_flag='2',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0' and (comment_id=#{commentId} or parent_comment_id=#{commentId}) and exists(select 1 from (select comment_id from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and comment_id=#{commentId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and parent_comment_id is null and del_flag='0') owned)
